verdict.rationale: Gladia is API-first: its docs present a single API for real-time and async transcription and enrichment, plus a CLI. The browser Playground is described as a place to test models and features before integrating, which suggests the core features are available programmatically. However, no evidence states that everything in the UI can be done through the API, and account, billing and credit top-up operations have no documented API coverage. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity statement, API coverage of account/billing/dashboard actions, published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: end-to-end audio infrastructure to record, transcribe and enrich audio through a single API
We offer a simple API to get transcription from your audios and videos, in both Real-time and asynchronous ways
